label: Clinic / Healthcare
description: Single or multi-doctor clinics, dental, physio, diagnostics, day-care centres.

headlineKpi.label: New reviews per week
headlineKpi.help: Steady, honest review flow is the strongest local signal for a clinic. Track the rate, not the total.

issueTaxonomy.label: Long waiting time
issueTaxonomy.action: Fix the waiting-time expectation: publish a realistic slot length, and have reception tell each patient the expected wait on arrival.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the wait past your appointment time

askOwner.question: Where does the waiting mostly happen?

issueTaxonomy.label: Appointment / booking problems
issueTaxonomy.action: Tighten the booking flow: confirm every appointment on the channel it was made, and re-confirm on the morning of the visit.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the trouble getting your appointment sorted

askOwner.question: Where do bookings most often go wrong?

issueTaxonomy.label: Unclear or unexpected billing
issueTaxonomy.action: Give a written estimate before treatment starts and repeat the total out loud before payment.

askOwner.question: Which part of billing surprises patients?
options: Final bill differs from the estimate

issueTaxonomy.label: Reception / staff behaviour
issueTaxonomy.action: Run a short front-desk script drill: greeting, expected wait, and how to answer a frustrated patient.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the way you were spoken to at the desk

issueTaxonomy.label: Cleanliness / hygiene
issueTaxonomy.action: Add a visible hourly cleaning checklist in the waiting area and washroom.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the state of the clinic when you visited

issueTaxonomy.label: Consultation felt rushed
issueTaxonomy.action: Protect a fixed minimum consultation length and end every consult with a one-line summary of the plan.

issueTaxonomy.label: Poor follow-up / report delays
issueTaxonomy.action: Set a promised turnaround for reports and send a status message if it will slip.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: humari taraf se jawab na milne

issueTaxonomy.label: Concern about treatment outcome
issueTaxonomy.action: Escalate offline: review the specific case privately with the doctor before any public reply.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: how things have gone since your visit

issueTaxonomy.label: Parking / access difficulty
issueTaxonomy.action: Add clear parking directions to the listing and to every appointment confirmation.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: how hard it was to park and get in

issueTaxonomy.label: Phone not answered
issueTaxonomy.action: Assign a named person to the clinic phone during opening hours and log missed calls daily.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: not being able to reach us on the phone
issueTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: phone par sampark na ho paane
issueTaxonomy.alternativeAction: Record a voicemail that promises a call back within the hour, and have reception clear it twice a day.

praiseTaxonomy.label: Doctor's care and explanation
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the doctor took the time to explain things
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: doctor ne sab kuch aaram se samjhaya

praiseTaxonomy.label: Friendly, helpful staff
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: team ne aapka acche se dhyan rakha

praiseTaxonomy.label: Clean, well-kept clinic
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the clinic felt clean and well kept

praiseTaxonomy.label: Fair, transparent pricing
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the pricing was clear and fair

praiseTaxonomy.label: Good treatment result
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: aap ab behtar mehsoos kar rahe hain

praiseTaxonomy.label: Modern equipment / facilities
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the facilities were up to standard

voicePreset.greeting: Thank you for taking the time to share this.
exampleReplies: Thank you for sharing this. We are sorry the wait was longer than expected. Please call the clinic and ask for the manager so we can look at your visit specifically.
Thank you for the kind words. We will pass this on to the team.

staffAskScript.when: At the billing counter, for every patient leaving — not only the ones who seemed pleased.
staffAskScript.line: There is a QR at the counter. However today went, we would like to know — it takes about a minute and only we see it.
staffAskScript.hinglishLine: Counter par QR hai. Aaj jaisa bhi raha, humein batayein — ek minute lagta hai aur sirf hum dekhte hain.
staffAskScript.marathiLine: काउंटरवर QR आहे. आज जसं झालं तसं आम्हाला कळवा — एक मिनिट लागतो आणि ते फक्त आम्हीच पाहतो.
doNot: Never offer a discount, gift, free consult or any reward for a review.
Never ask only the happy patients — offer the same QR to everyone.
Never fill in or dictate a review for a patient.
Never ask a patient to change or delete a review.
Never wait until someone looks happy — offer the QR to everyone, every time.
Never ask a customer to leave a public review as a condition of anything.

contentTemplates.label: Reply — long wait
contentTemplates.body:
Thank you for telling us. A longer wait than we promised is on us, not on you. Please call the clinic and ask for the manager, mentioning the day of your visit, so we can look at what happened.

— Team {{businessName}}

contentTemplates.label: Reply — positive review
contentTemplates.body:
Thank you for taking the time to write this. We will share it with the team — it means a lot.

— Team {{businessName}}

contentTemplates.label: Counter card subhead
contentTemplates.body: Scan and tell us honestly. It takes a minute.

kit.placement: At the billing counter, facing patients as they settle up.
kit.moment: At the billing counter, for every patient leaving — not only the ones who seemed pleased.
kit.headline: Was today’s visit helpful?
kit.subhead: Scan and tell us honestly. It takes a minute.
kit.askMessage: Thank you for visiting {{businessName}}. If today’s visit was helpful, would you share your honest experience? It takes about a minute: {{feedbackUrl}}
kit.askMessageHinglish: Aapka {{businessName}} aane ke liye dhanyawaad. Agar aaj ka visit theek raha ho, toh apna honest feedback share kar dijiye — ek minute lagega: {{feedbackUrl}}
kit.askMessageMarathi: {{businessName}} ला भेट दिल्याबद्दल धन्यवाद. आजची भेट उपयुक्त वाटली असेल, तर तुमचा प्रामाणिक अनुभव नोंदवाल का? एक मिनिट लागेल: {{feedbackUrl}}
kit.thankYou: Thank you — we read every one of these.

gateway.headline: How was your visit?
gateway.prompt: Tell us what went well, or what we could do better.
gateway.placeholder: The waiting, the doctor, the front desk — anything you noticed.
gateway.thankYou: Thank you. The clinic team reads every one of these.
gateway.printLine: Honest feedback helps us look after you better.
